reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: 25P0998 & 25P0999, Householder and Listed Building Consent for renovation of existing property, conversion of stable to livable space and erection of new single storey rear extension.
description:
LISTED BUILDING CONSENT FOR THE INSTALLATION OF AIR
CONDITIONING CONDENSER UNITS AND AN ASSOCIATED ACOUSTIC ENCLOSURE ON THE FLAT
ROOF OF THE APPROVED SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION. THE EQUIPMENT WILL BE
POSITIONED IN A DISCREET LOCATION AWAY FROM THE PRINCIPAL ELEVATIONS OF THE
GRADE II LISTED BUILDING AND SCREENED TO MINIMISE VISIBILITY FROM SURROUNDING
VIEWPOINTS.
decision_conditions:
Commencement of development (LB Consent) - The works hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of 3 years from the date of this consent.

Reason: To comply with the requirements of Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

<p><span style="white-space: pre; white-space: normal;">	</span></p><div style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;; line-height: 20px;"><div style="line-height: 20px;"><div style="line-height: 20px;"><div style="line-height: 20px;">Prior to the first operation of the air conditioning condenser and associated plant hereby approved, the plant, acoustic enclosure and associated mitigation measures shall be installed in full in accordance with the recommendations and mitigation measures contained within the Noise Impact Assessment prepared by Eurovib Acoustic Products Ltd (Ref: CPT-170526-010-R1, dated 3 June 2026), including the provision of the acoustic enclosure and anti-vibration measures specified therein.</div></div><div style="line-height: 20px;"><br></div><div style="line-height: 20px;">Prior to the first use of the plant, a validation noise assessment undertaken by a suitably qualified acoustic consultant shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The assessment shall demonstrate that the rating level of noise emitted from the plant and equipment does not exceed 34.8 dB LAr,T during the hours of 07:00-23:00 and 34.9 dB LAr,T during the hours of 23:00-07:00 at the nearest noise-sensitive receptor, as identified within the approved Noise Impact Assessment, when assessed in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019.&nbsp;</div><div style="line-height: 20px;"><br></div><div style="line-height: 20px;">The plant, acoustic enclosure and mitigation measures shall thereafter be permanently retained and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</div></div></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;; line-height: 20px;"><br></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;; line-height: 20px;"><span style="font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">Reason:&nbsp; To safeguard the amenities of the area and the occupiers of neighbouring properties and ensure compliance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D14 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.1 &amp; D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></div>
